name: Teman
description: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The dukes of the sons of Esau: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz, Korah, Gatam and Amalek, all sons of Eliphaz, his firstborn. Remember them; they are around today under names like German, Israeli and Polish.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Job's three friends heard of all this evil that came upon him: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. They made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

After the Most High had spoken these words, He tells Eliphaz the Temanite that His wrath is kindled against him and his two friends, because they have not spoken of Him the thing that is right, as His servant Job has. Throughout the book Job's three friends dealt wrongly with him after his children were killed and everything was taken, so they did not deal righteously as their brother Job did.

note.label: Job 42: The Lord Turned the Captivity of Job

points: This is how the priesthood worked, all the way from Leviticus and the five books throughout history: we brought the sacrifice to the Levites and priests and they did it on our behalf, and if a man did not bring his sacrifice, the Most High would deal with him and what he did would not be forgiven. Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the Most High commanded, and He accepted Job.

note.label: Job 42: The Lord Turned the Captivity of Job
